text: And I'm going to make them go right. There's no use wailing out here in the West. A line or two of Laurence Hope's has been running all day through my head: "These are my people, and this my land; I hear the pulse of her secret soul. This is the life that I understand, Savage and simple, and sane and whole." Friday the Eleventh Dinky-dunk came home with an Indian girl to-day, a young half-breed about sixteen years old.
